This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in United Kingdom. 
 Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.
 Accountabilities 
 You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:
 Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.
 Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.
 Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.
 Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.
 Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.
 Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.
 Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.
 Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.
 Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.
 Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.
 Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.
 Requirements
 The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:
 At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.
 Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.
 Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.
 Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.
 Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.
 Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.
 Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.
 Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.
 Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.
 Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.
 Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.
 Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
 A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.
 Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.
 Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.
 A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.
 A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

 Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.
 Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.
 Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.
 Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.
 Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.
 Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.
 Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.
 Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.
 Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

Role Overview 
 We are seeking an Automotive Systems Diagnostic and Troubleshooting Engineer to diagnose vehicle systems independently, troubleshoot and repair electrical systems, and create comprehensive guided troubleshooting content for automotive applications.

 Diagnose electronic, mechanical, and electrical system problems in vehicles using industry-standard testers and diagnostic tools, including OBD-II scanners, multimeters, and oscilloscopes
 Identify and interpret Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) to understand specific error codes and determine root causes

 Software Engineer 
 About the company:  
 In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.
 KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.
 Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.
 KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.
 KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.
 We are hiring Software Engineers to accelerate our mission.
 About The Role: 
 At KoBold, software engineers have the unique opportunity to embed directly with their users and learn the ins and outs of mineral exploration and geology while developing state of the art technology solutions. Unlike traditional software engineering roles, we don’t simply ship code and passively wait for feedback about its utility: our userbase includes our colleagues… and ourselves! While there are real technical challenges in making mineral exploration data broadly searchable and accessible to both humans and machines, we believe that solving these technical challenges cannot be done without “getting our hands dirty” – sometimes literally! – by embedding directly with the exploration teams and even occasionally (~once a year) joining our colleagues in the field, be it in Zambia, Canada, or Arizona, to experience the impact of our software in real time.
 As a Software Engineer on the Data Systems Engineering team at KoBold, your main role will be to enable systematic exploration and materially improve exploration success rates by making mineral exploration data broadly accessible to humans and machines.  Past projects have included SIP (the Structured Ingest Pipeline), DataKit generation (producing curated sets of data on demand), and RAG (Retrieval Augmentation Generation, utilizing natural language processing on unstructured data). Our tech stack is primarily python and includes Django, React, AWS, and additional technologies like Retool and Prefect. 
 Your work will empower KoBold to unlock invaluable insights and streamline intricate scientific processes. Collaborating with our exceptional team of data scientists, geologists, and other software engineers, you will have the opportunity to tackle complex problems head-on and collectively pave the way for the discoveries of vital energy transition metals like lithium, copper, nickel, and cobalt. Together we can shape the future of mineral exploration and contribute to building a sustainable world.
 This role be responsible for:
 Deep engagement with exploration geologists and data scientists, continual learning about mineral exploration, and tailoring technology development to the needs of exploration project scientists
 Building data pipelines and tooling for deriving advanced human and machine insights from exploration data, often leading a small group of software engineers to successful delivery
 Developing expertise in KoBold’s Data Systems and deeply understanding how they impact exploration
 End-to-end ownership of projects from design to implementation and testing to continued engagement with colleagues on exploration teams using your solutions
 Responding well to design and code feedback, also providing feedback to teammates 
 Operationally managing the team’s services and assisting scientific colleagues with our tooling
 Qualifications 
 4+ years of software engineering experience, ideally building production cloud data systems
 Proficiency with Python
 Ability to write production-quality code that is correct, readable, well-tested, scalable and extensible
 Skilled in large-scale system design
 A track record of taking ownership from definition of the problem and delivering projects with demonstrated impact in an iterative manner
 Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
 Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not software developers. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
 Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.
 Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
 Nice to Haves 
 Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React
 Experience with geospatial data and building map-based experiences
 Familiarity with containerization and container orchestration platforms, such as Docker, AWS ECS, Kubernetes, etc.
 Formal education or job exposure to natural sciences
 The UK base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $120,000 - $210,000 USD.
 Location: Remote, Candidates can be located anywhere in the United Kingdom. 
 What to Expect 
 Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

The Impact You'll Make
 Would you like to bring technology directly to customers and build long-term relationships along the way? As a Junior Service Application Engineer (m/f/d) , you will support our customers with the commissioning, maintenance, and optimization of modern drive systems while developing into their trusted service partner.
At Danfoss Drives, you will help ensure that industrial plants operate reliably, efficiently, and sustainably. Step by step, you will take on greater responsibility for your customers and build long-lasting customer relationships.
This position can be based flexibly in the Essen , Offenbach , or Hamburg region.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 In this role, you will be trained and mentored by our experienced Service Application Engineers. You will gain extensive hands-on field experience and expand your knowledge of advanced drive technologies. Your responsibilities will include:
 Intensive onboarding and structured training on our drive systems and service portfolio
 Accompanying experienced colleagues on customer assignments throughout Germany and, after the training phase, taking responsibility for your own customers
 Rotating through relevant service and support functions
 Gradually developing toward independently carrying out service activities (e.g., commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades)
 Supporting customer projects and solving problems directly on site
 Building strong application expertise and customer-facing skills
 What We're Looking For
 You are a qualified electrical technician with a completed vocational qualification in electrical engineering 
 Ideally, you have already completed further training as a State-Certified Technician or Master Craftsman, or you are interested in pursuing this alongside your job 
 Solid electrical engineering knowledge and a passion for analyzing and solving technical problems systematically 
 Enthusiasm for field service work, a customer-focused approach, and strong communication skills 
 Valid Class B driver’s license and a high willingness to travel: initially, travel is expected to account for approximately 40-50% of your working time and may increase as you take on greater responsibility 
 Fluent German and good written and spoken English skills 
 What You'll Get From Us
 We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
 You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.
 We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are. 
 You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.
 Ready to Make a Difference?
 If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife. 
 Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis . Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften . Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie . 
 Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany. 
 Für unseren Bereich  Costing suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine n engagierte n Analytics Engineer , der/die unsere Datenarchitektur im Bereich der direkten Kosten (Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Steuern) auf das nächste Level hebt. In dieser Schlüsselposition bist du das Bindeglied zwischen komplexen regulatorischen Anforderungen, energiewirtschaftlichen Forecasts und unserer Pricing-Strategie. Du liebst es, skalierbare Daten-Pipelines zu bauen, behältst bei wechselnden regulatorischen Vorgaben den Überblick und hast den Anspruch, unsere Systeme durch eine moderne Neuarchitektur zukunftssicher zu machen.
 Deine Aufgaben: 
 Datenarchitektur & Pipeline Architektur 
 Du verantwortest die Neuarchitektur unserer Datenlandschaft zur Abbildung der direkten Kosten im Energievertrieb.
 Du konzipierst und implementierst robuste ETL/ELT-Pipelines mittels dbt und Airflow , um Daten aus regulatorischen Quellen, Marktdaten und internen Systemen effizient zu verarbeiten.
 Du stellst die Datenqualität und -konsistenz sicher, die als direkte Entscheidungsgrundlage für unser Pricing dient.
 Fachliche Konzeption & Monitoring 
 Regulatorisches Monitoring & Implementierung: Du behältst die regulatorischen Entwicklungen im Energiemarkt (wie Änderungen bei Netzentgelten, Steuern und Umlagen) aktiv im Blick und übersetzt diese eigenständig in die notwendigen Anpassungen unserer Datenmodelle und Pipelines.
 Du entwickelst und pflegst Forecast-Modelle für unsere Kostenkomponenten und stellst sicher, dass sich regulatorische Änderungen zeitnah und präzise in den Prognosen widerspiegeln.
 Du übersetzt komplexe energiewirtschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen in performante, logische Datenstrukturen.
 Strategische Zusammenarbeit 
 Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Schnittstellen Pricing, Energy Markets (Einkauf/Forecasting) und Gross Margin Controlling.
 Du berätst die Stakeholder bei der methodischen Weiterentwicklung der Kostenberechnung und stellst sicher, dass die analytischen Outputs direkt in die Business-Strategie einfließen.
 Du treibst die technische Weiterentwicklung des Teams voran, indem du Best Practices in der Datenmodellierung etablierst.
 Dein Background: 
 Du hast ein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem ähnlichen quantitativen Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
 Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung (Mid-Level bis Senior) als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit.
 Du bist ein Profi im Umgang mit SQL und Python. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit dbt und Apache Airflow in produktiven Umgebungen gesammelt.
 Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Datenarchitekturen und die Fähigkeit, dynamische fachliche/regulatorische Anforderungen in sauberen, wartbaren Code zu übersetzen.
 Du arbeitest analytisch, konzeptionell und findest pragmatische Lösungen für technische Herausforderungen.
 Du kommunizierst klar – auf Deutsch und Englisch – und kannst fachliche Komplexität für Stakeholder verständlich aufbereiten.
 Du hast eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität: Du baust Systeme nicht nur, du verantwortest ihren Betrieb und ihre kontinuierliche Anpassung an den Markt.
 Deine Benefits bei uns: 
 ✅ Vergünstigungen & Vorsorge: 
 - Aktienoptionen der Octopus Energy Group Ltd. 
 - Vergünstigte Konditionen für unsere Strom- und Gastarife 
 - Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Nahverkehrsticket 
 - Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Mittagessen 
 - Vergünstigtes Fahrradleasing 
 - Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Nachhaltig unterwegs mit unserem E-Auto-Leasing 
 ✅ Familie 
 - Beratungsangebote und Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuung über HeyNanny 
 - Monatlicher Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung 
 - Elterngeld-Bonus: Wir stocken dein Elterngeld für 3 Monate auf, damit du deine Elternzeit entspannter genießen kannst  
 ✅ Sport & Gesundheit 
 - Zuzahlungen zu Fitness- Angeboten über Wellpass 
 - Förderung deines mentalen Wohlbefindens mit unserem Partner Open Up 
 ✅ Lernen & Weiterbildung 
 - Attraktive Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten 
 - Kostenlose Sprachkurse über Busuu 
 ✅ Extra Goodies 
 - Gutschein zu deinem Geburtstag

About the team 
 The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.
 This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.
 About the Role 
 As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows.
 Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.
 This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work.
 In this role, you will: 
 Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software.
 Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption.
 Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability.
 Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform.

YOUR JOB 
 AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.
 WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA 
 We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.
 Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.
 Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.
 Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.
 Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.
 Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.
 WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN 
 The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world
 Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs
 Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market
 Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget
 Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.
 THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD 
 You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.
 You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.
 You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.
 Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.
 You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.
 You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.
 You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.
 LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS: 
 No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. About us
 Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.
 Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany. 
 Please submit your CV in English 
 About the role:
  We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.
 In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.
 In particular, you will be responsible for:
 Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.
 Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.
 Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.
 Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.
 Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. 
 About you
 Required qualifications / experience:
 Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
 Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.
 Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.
 Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.
 Technical stack: 
 Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks ( PyTorch , Hugging Face ecosystem).
 Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.
 Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).
  Preferred qualifications/bonus:
 Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).
 Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
 Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.
  #LI-HB1
 What we offer
 Flexible work organization
 Friendly and informal working environment
 Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds
 Recruitment Process & Security
 Please complete the form and submit your CV.
 Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.
 Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:
 Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.
 Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @ owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).
 The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @ Owkin.com .
 The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;
 Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger 
 Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.
 If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,
 Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn
 Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ 
 Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities 
 Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 About the Role
 As SAR Remote Sensing Engineer, you are the subject matter expert on applying advanced signal processing and machine learning to SAR data within our RF analytics team. You own the analytics layer end to end: algorithm design, real-time implementation and field validation on real captures from our own platforms. You will also shape the move toward multi-modal solutions that combine SAR with optical and RF sensor feeds. Cycles are measured in months, and the scope grows with the company.
 Responsibilities
 Lead initiatives using SAR polarimetry and coherence for automated change detection.
 Design and prototype state-of-the-art machine learning models for SAR image segmentation.
 Develop algorithms for target detection and object classification on SAR data.
 Fuse SAR with optical, RF and other data sources to support GNSS-denied operations.
 Port algorithms from Python prototypes to real-time pipelines with software and embedded/FPGA teams.
 Build the capture, labelling and replay tooling that makes performance claims reproducible.
 Validate performance on simulated and real-world datasets, in the lab and on field-test campaigns.
 Work with radar, radio, electronic warfare and computer vision teams to define what the analytics layer needs from each sensor.
 Candidate Requirements
 Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, telecommunications engineering, signal processing, applied mathematics or a related field.
 3+ years of experience in radar signal processing or SAR remote sensing.
 Deep understanding of SAR phenomenology and its information content, including coherence, amplitude, phase and polarimetry.
 Theoretical and practical expertise in machine learning, both deep learning and classical techniques.
 Experience taking at least one algorithm from prototype to real hardware running on real signals.
 Strong Python skills and sound engineering practices (Git, code reviews, testing, documentation).
 Exposure to GEOINT, ELINT or SIGINT work is a plus, and you are comfortable with defense security vetting.
 Willingness to travel periodically to lab and field tests.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

At Hudson River Trading (HRT) the Applied AI team’s mission is to increase the speed and quality of work across the firm’s most consequential workflows. We build AI systems that help researchers and developers iterate faster, automate increasingly complex work, and enable autonomous exploration at a scale that would not otherwise be possible.
 We apply frontier models and agentic systems to how quantitative research, software development, and other critical work at HRT gets done. We combine cutting-edge commercial and open-source models and tools with infrastructure, research, and systems of our own.
 Our work spans the full stack required to make this successful: AI infrastructure, research engineering, post-training and reinforcement learning, agent evaluation, security and alignment, and deployment into real workflows.
 Responsibilities 
 Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:
 Building scalable infrastructure for training, evaluating, and operating language models and AI agents
 Developing research environments, evaluation systems, and experimentation platforms that allow us to measure and improve agent performance
 Improving model and agent capabilities through post-training, reinforcement learning, prompting, tool design, and workflow optimization
 Designing sandboxing, policy enforcement, monitoring, and other safeguards for increasingly capable autonomous systems
 Partnering with teams across HRT to identify work AI can newly perform, develop effective solutions, and turn successful experiments into durable systems
 Evaluating new models, techniques, and products, and making informed decisions about when to build, buy, or adapt them
 Sharing technical knowledge and establishing effective practices for building and working with AI across HRT
 Profile 
 You are an excellent engineer who can turn ambiguous problems into working systems
 You learn unfamiliar technical and business domains quickly and enjoy moving between them
 You care about advancing what AI systems can reliably accomplish
 You use rigorous measurement and experiment design to guide decisions
 You are comfortable operating across research and production engineering
 You communicate clearly and collaborate well with people from different technical backgrounds
 You are curious about the capabilities, limitations, and risks of increasingly autonomous systems
 We do not expect any candidate to have prior experience in every area covered by the team. We value demonstrated depth, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to learn.
 Qualifications 
 Required: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience required
 Strong Python proficiency required
 Excellent software design, debugging, and problem-solving skills required
 Experience building and operating substantial software systems required
 Demonstrated engagement with modern AI systems, tools, or research required
 Experience in one or more of the following is helpful: 
 Machine learning research or engineering, including post-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or alignment
 AI-agent architecture, evaluation, or tool-use environments
 Distributed systems, model serving, orchestration, or high-throughput research infrastructure
 Security sandboxing, policy enforcement, adversarial testing, or governance for AI systems
 Forward-deployed engineering: working closely with users to discover, build, and operationalize new capabilities
 Linux, systems performance, networking, C++, or TypeScript
 The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.
 Culture 
 Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading. 
 At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office. 
Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.
Your Role 
 As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.
 This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.
 How the role contributes to our vision
 bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.
 As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
 Top priorities
 Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.
 Maintain and evolve our design system , together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.
 Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams , with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.
 Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality , raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.
 Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.
 Your first 90 days
 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.
 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.
 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.
 About you
 Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.
 Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.
 AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.
 Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.
 Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.
 Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.
 Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.
 Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.
 Our tech stack
 Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.
 Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js
 Database: MySQL
 Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS
 Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub
 Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta
 Internal Tools: Retool
 Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid
 Forms: Tally
 Workplace & Benefits
 Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more
 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays
 Remote-flexible hybrid setup
 Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year
 A great tech and work setup
 Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains
 Hiring process
 Initial screening with Talent Acquisition (30 min): get acquainted with bunch, explore your motivation, and understand whether what we offer matches what you are looking for.
 Hiring Manager call — Engineering (60 min): a conversation with Engineering leadership focused on your scope, frontend leadership, product-engineering mindset, and how you diagnose and lead systemic improvements.
 Technical Interview (60 min): a hands-on technical conversation focused on frontend engineering craft, TypeScript, component design, maintainability, testing, and pragmatic problem-solving.
 Technical Interview — System Design (60 min): a frontend/system design conversation focused on architecture, data flow, performance, accessibility, reliability, and trade-offs in complex product systems.
 VP Product conversation (45 min): a cross-functional conversation focused on product thinking, customer empathy, business acumen, and how you partner with Product and Design on ambiguous problems.
 Final round (45 min): a closing conversation to align on what we heard across the process, answer remaining questions, and discuss expectations for the role and trial period.
 About bunch 
 bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.
 We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

items.jobTitle: Hardware-Aware Model Optimisation - Member of Technical Staff
items.jobDescription:
About Us 
 We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.
 Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.
 The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.
 Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.
 Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.
 In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.
 We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.
 About the Role 
 Callosum believes that the next generation of AI systems will emerge from models and hardware being optimised together. Today's model architectures have largely evolved around the capabilities of conventional GPUs, leaving significant opportunities unexplored as new accelerator architectures emerge. We are building infrastructure that allows models to be adapted to different computational substrates, rather than treating them as fixed algorithms that hardware must accommodate.
 This role explores how model architectures and inference algorithms can be adapted to exploit heterogeneous hardware, creating specialised variants with different trade-offs between capability, latency, and cost. You will investigate transformations spanning numerics, sparsity, model structure, memory, and execution, alongside new algorithms designed around emerging accelerators. A central part of the work is developing automated approaches to these adaptations and rigorous evaluations that establish when the resulting models offer meaningful advantages.
 What You'll Build 
 Develop hardware-aware transformations that adapt models to different accelerator architectures and execution environments.
 Explore numerical, structural, and memory-related optimisations to create model variants with different capability, latency, and cost trade-offs.
 Investigate new inference algorithms, including speculative decoding, designed to exploit heterogeneous computational resources.
 Develop automated methods for discovering, characterising, and optimising hardware-specialised model variants.
 Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations.
 What Sets You Apart 
 Deep understanding of modern LLM architectures, including attention mechanisms, model structure, and their implications for inference.
 Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning.
 Familiarity with a range of architectures, such as mixture-of-experts, diffusion, JEPA, or alternative attention mechanisms.
 Strong intuition for the interactions between model capability, numerical behaviour, memory requirements, and execution efficiency.
 Experience designing rigorous experiments to assess model quality, efficiency, and the effects of architectural modifications.
 What We Offer 
 Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience
 Equity & Ownership
 Private healthcare
 We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world
 We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us
 We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Functie  Reliability engineer 
 Beschrijving functie 
 De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.
 De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 
 Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.
 Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem
 Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.
 Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.
 Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.
 Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout
 Taken 
 Trouble shooting 
 Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen
 Daily problem solving
 Continue verbeteren 
 Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten
 Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid
 Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten
 Change Management 
 Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 
 Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines
 Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 
 Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid 
 Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark
 Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.
 Investeringsprojecten 
 Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.
 Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.
 Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.
 Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen 
 Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten
 Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 You will own how we prove that our aircraft are hard to detect. While design teams shape geometry and materials, you will show whether those choices hold up under measurement. You will set the low observability (LO) testing roadmap, specify and build our own radar cross-section (RCS) and infrared (IR) test facilities, and define the procedures by which signature performance is verified. You will also scope and supervise the work of external measurement laboratories, then scrutinise the data they return. Your standards will become the reference point for every LO measurement we make, and your evidence will inform design decisions on a flagship aircraft programme.
 The day-to-day
 Build and maintain the multi-year LO testing roadmap, so that measurement capability is in place before each programme milestone requires it 
 Specify, design and commission in-house LO test facilities, such as anechoic chambers, compact or far-field ranges, pylon systems and radar hardware, including calibration regimes that hold measurement uncertainty within agreed limits 
 Write master verification and validation test plans for RCS and IR signature measurement at component, subsystem and full-aircraft level 
 Produce detailed test procedures that deliver consistent, repeatable results across campaigns, sites and suppliers 
 Define statements of work for subcontracted testing, guide those suppliers technically, and accept or reject delivered measurement data on evidence 
 You should apply if you
 Have planned and run RCS measurement campaigns, and can trace a signature result back to the physics and the test set-up that produced it 
 Have specified, built or operated antenna or RCS test facilities, including near-field, far-field or compact ranges 
 Work fluently with high-frequency measurement equipment such as vector network analysers, signal generators and spectrum analysers 
 Apply systems engineering practice to verification and validation, from requirements through test plans to signed-off test reports 
 Communicate technical reasoning clearly in written and spoken in English and German, to customers as well as engineering colleagues 
 Hold, or are willing and able to obtain, an extended German security clearance (erweiterte Sicherheitsüberprüfung, Ü2 or Ü3) 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to have
 Experience measuring infrared signatures alongside radar cross-section
 What We Offer

 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation 
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance 
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) 
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances 
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers 
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

 The Mission of the Forward Deployed AI Engineer
 In this role, you'll be the hands-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools analysts use to protect nations.
 Who We Are
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Day To Day Responsibilities
 Platform Deployment & Integration
 Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centers).
 Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters.
 Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools.
 Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access.
 AI Solution Development & Customization
 Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that combine ICEYE SAR data with customer intelligence documents for context-aware analysis.
 Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks.
 Implement prompt engineering strategies and conversational AI interfaces that enable analysts to query satellite data using natural language.
 Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources.
 Data Fusion & Intelligence Workflows
 Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT).
 Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities.
 Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs.
 Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping
 Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems.
 Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements.
 Conduct hands-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage.
 Gather customer feedback and translate it into technical requirements for ICEYE's product and engineering teams.
 What we are looking for
 Must Have Skills
 3+ years hands-on software engineering building and deploying production systems.
 Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust.
 Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems.
 Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic-ai) and vector databases.
 Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air-gapped environments.
 Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production,
 Familiarity with Linux and basic Kubernetes operations.
 Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritize working solutions over perfect architecture.
 Strong communication + customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators.
 Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region.
 Nice To Have Skills
 Experience in defense, intelligence, or government operational environments.
 Deploying to on-prem data centers and/or air-gapped networks.
 Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing.
 Experience with MCP integrations, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
 Deeper Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/Ansible), and/or offline CI/CD.
 Understanding of intelligence analysis workflows and defense/government requirements.
 Experience with data fusion, multi-source intelligence integration, or GIS tools (ArcGIS, QGIS).
 Background in solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer success.
 Experience in defense tech (e.g., Palantir, Anduril, Scale AI, similar startups).

 Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centers).
 Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters.
 Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools.
 Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access.
 AI Solution Development & Customization

 Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks.

 Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources.
 Data Fusion & Intelligence Workflows
 Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT).
 Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities.
 Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs.
 Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping
 Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems.
 Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements.
 Conduct hands-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage.

 Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust.
 Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems.
 Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic-ai) and vector databases.
 Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air-gapped environments.
 Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production,
 Familiarity with Linux and basic Kubernetes operations.
 Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritize working solutions over perfect architecture.
 Strong communication + customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators.
 Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region.
 Nice To Have Skills
 Experience in defense, intelligence, or government operational environments.
 Deploying to on-prem data centers and/or air-gapped networks.
 Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing.
 Experience with MCP integrations, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
 Deeper Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/Ansible), and/or offline CI/CD.
 Understanding of intelligence analysis workflows and defense/government requirements.
 Experience with data fusion, multi-source intelligence integration, or GIS tools (ArcGIS, QGIS).
 Background in solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer success.
 Experience in defense tech (e.g., Palantir, Anduril, Scale AI, similar startups).

 Working at ICEYE

 How We Work (Our Values)

 Benefits

 Our commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
