A World-Changing Company 
 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. 
 The Role
 We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment.
As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements.
This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice. 
 Core Responsibilities 
 Design, implement, and improve security controls across endpoints, servers, identity systems, cloud services, SaaS applications, networks, and data flows.
 Drive security posture improvements through hardening standards, configuration management, vulnerability remediation, access controls, monitoring, and ongoing validation.
 Assess security risks in new platforms, products, architectures, vendors, and services, and turn findings into practical recommendations and engineering work.
 Build and maintain automation for security operations, including configuration validation, drift monitoring, patching, access reviews, policy enforcement, alert triage, and security hygiene.
 Partner with Identity, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, and other Information Security teams to strengthen security architecture and address recurring risks.
 Turn insights from assessments, red team exercises, incident investigations, and operational reviews into durable fixes, such as configuration changes, architectural improvements, policy updates, and automation.
 Build expertise in one or more security domains while contributing across the broader infrastructure security lifecycle.
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience securing one or more major infrastructure domains, such as Windows, macOS, Linux, Active Directory, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, networking, identity systems, or enterprise endpoints.
 A broad infrastructure security mindset and curiosity about systems beyond your primary area of expertise.
 Familiarity with common infrastructure attack paths, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and the controls used to prevent, detect, and contain them.
 The ability to assess complex environments and recognize how weaknesses across identity, endpoints, applications, networks, cloud services, or data flows can combine to create risk.
 Experience evaluating security tools and validating that controls are deployed effectively and continue to work as intended.
 Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, CI/CD, or other approaches to making security controls repeatable and scalable.
 What We Value 
 The ability to own projects, make progress through ambiguity, and balance competing priorities while working well with colleagues.
 Experience in complex, high-assurance, regulated, or rapidly changing environments.
 Comfort moving between strategic problem-solving and hands-on technical work.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and work with partner teams to drive remediation.
 Contributions to security programs, tooling, automation, incident investigations, or technical research—whether public or internal.
 What We Require 
 5+ years of hands-on experience in information security, infrastructure security, security engineering, security operations, or a closely related field.
 Demonstrated experience securing at least one major infrastructure or security domain, with the ability and interest to work across multiple domains.
 Active TS/SCI security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one.
 A strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and integrity.
 Life at Palantir 
 We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. 
 In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. 
 If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process , please and let us know how we can help. 
 Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) . Overview 
 We're looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology.
 Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.
 You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.
 There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).
 Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.
 What you'll be doing: 
 AI System Architecture: Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.
 Infrastructure & Production Engineering: Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.
 Rapid Client Prototyping: Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, while maintaining the engineering standards required for production deployment.
 Domain Translation & Integration: Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.
 Agent Evaluation & Optimisation: Developing frameworks to measure, monitor and improve agent performance. You will design evaluation strategies, identify failure modes, and apply systematic testing to ensure agents are reliable, predictable and effective in real-world environments.
 What you need to succeed: 
 Applied AI Expertise: You have hands-on experience building LLM-based agentic systems, with a solid grasp of the fundamentals: planning, reasoning, tool use, memory and orchestration. You know how to evaluate and monitor agents so you can measure how they perform in production.
 Core Software Fluency: You possess strong programming skills, good testing and deployment practices, and practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You can design scalable, resilient systems, and you know that great agents still require excellent software engineering foundations.
 Navigating Ambiguity: You are comfortable working with uncertainty and evolving requirements. You break complex, ill-defined problems into clear, logical steps. You recognise that requirements evolve as new information emerges and can make sound engineering judgements about when rapid experimentation is appropriate and when a more rigorous approach is required.
 Communication: You communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently, adapting your style to different audiences. You are comfortable engaging with clients, engineers, scientists and business leaders, ensuring technical insights translate into meaningful decisions and outcomes.
 Collaboration and Influence: You know how to challenge constructively, influence through evidence and insight, and help others navigate trade-offs in fast-moving environments.
 Problem Solving: You enjoy tackling complex technical challenges and can quickly distil ambiguity into actionable plans. You combine analytical thinking with pragmatism to identify the right solution and move projects forward.
 Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria. Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been continuously resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.
 What we offer: 
 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)
 Company bonus (profit share)
 Flexible working patterns and hybrid working
 Medical insurance and group income protection
 Employee assistance programme and mental health support group
 Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
 Sabbatical leave
 Travel insurance (business and leisure)
 Generous company pension plan
 Personalised career development and training plans
 Free subscription to professional bodies
 Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day
 Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links
 A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!
 Why Cambridge Consultants? 
 At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. Whether you're advancing technologies, shaping strategy, supporting operations or driving commercial growth, it's an opportunity to make a real impact and help create the future.
